response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), grand_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_mean FROM account_averages), above_mean AS (SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount - gm.overall_mean as difference FROM account_averages aa CROSS JOIN grand_mean gm WHERE aa.avg_amount > gm.overall_mean) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, difference FROM above_mean ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
